sloka: विससर्ज ततो गंगाम् हरो बिन्दु सरः प्रति ।तस्यम् विसृउज्यमानायाम् सप्त स्रोतंसि जज्ञिरे ॥१-४३-११॥
transliteration: visasarja tato gaṁgām haro bindu saraḥ prati ।tasyam visṛujyamānāyām sapta srotaṁsi jajñire ॥1-43-11॥

translations.english: As she (Ganga) was released, she branched out into seven streams. Three streams known as Hladini, Pavani and Nalini having auspicious waters and conferring prosperity flowed eastwards.
